chat.title: Prediction Builder Assistant
chat.subtitle: Describe your analysis. AI proposes structured draft changes for you to review individually.
chat.initialMessage: Describe the market analysis you need. I will structure timeframes, horizon, indicators, and long, short, and no-trade rules as a reviewable draft.
chat.placeholder: Describe the analysis goal, rules, and exclusions...
chat.starterTrendText: Analyze RSI trend pullbacks on 15m with a 4 hour horizon. Long only with confirmed trend and momentum; no trade on conflicting or missing data.
chat.starterBreakoutText: Analyze breakouts on 1h with volume confirmation and clear invalidation. Long and short are allowed; no trade without follow-through volume.
chat.starterRiskText: Evaluate RSI on 15m. News risk, conflicting indicators, or missing data must always result in no-trade.
chat.replyNeedTimeframes: Good. Select the timeframes and run timeframe next so the prompt knows which context it should evaluate.
chat.replyNeedIndicators: I captured that. Next, mark the indicators the prompt is actually allowed to use.
chat.replyNeedRisk: Good start. Add risk and exit rules, such as when to stay neutral, when to ignore SL/TP, or which setups to exclude.
chat.replyAnalysisReady: All set. Analysis mode is prepared with neutral defaults. You can add more analysis preferences or generate a preview.
chat.replyReady: Captured. The description is updated. You can send more details or generate the prompt preview now.
chat.aiUnavailable: AI could not answer right now. I copied your input into the description locally; you can try again in a moment.
chat.readyForPreview: AI brief updated. You can generate the prompt preview now.
chat.briefHeader: Chat-based strategy brief for the AI prompt generator
